summary: iter-352: end-to-end verification of (A) role-based End Implant Treatment approval workflow and (B) R0 → R{n} data substitution on GET /procedures/{id}. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering student/supervisor/in-charge initiators, supervisor!=incharge two-step chain, same-person-both single-step collapse, both 403 role-gate paths, reject-without-comment (HTTP 400) + reject-with-comment (revert + downgrade Treatment Ended → Failed + audit metadata), dashboard pending_my_approval increments, /procedures?filter=pending_all includes both new statuses, R0→R{n} substitution correctly clears healing_abutment_mm when R{n} switches to Cover Screw, and no-review path leaves implants[] unmodified. Frontend (Playwright): (1) EndTreatmentPendingBanner renders on the seeded case for Abhijit.patil with orange styling, 'Awaiting Dr. Abhijit Patil approval' subtitle, meta box (Initiated by / on, Decision by, Reason), and Approve+Reject buttons. (2) Reject flow: modal opens, empty confirm keeps state unchanged (React Native Alert), typed comment → rejected banner (data-testid=end-treatment-rejected-banner) appears with 'Rejected by Dr. Abhijit Patil · implant_incharge' + quoted reason and status header switches to 'Phase 2 Approved — Ready for Phase 3'. (3) Approve flow (same-person-both collapse): single tap terminates the case; termination banner (data-testid=termination-banner) with 'Implant Treatment Terminated', 'Ended by Patient · 12 July 2026', reason box and Download Summary PDF button all render. (4) Student view (Gaurav.pandey): pending banner renders in read-only mode — Approve/Reject buttons absent, 'You do not have approval rights on this request.' text visible.

issues: Recurring console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — cosmetic React Native web warning; does not affect functionality but should be traced to a stray whitespace/text sibling inside a View (likely in one of the recently-added banners).

action_items: LOW: track down the 'Unexpected text node' console warning in [id].tsx or EndTreatmentPendingBanner.tsx — probably a stray whitespace between JSX tags rendered inside a <View> instead of <Text>. Non-functional but noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L4649-4818: `approve_end_treatment` endpoint is well-structured. Role gate correctly checks assigned supervisor/incharge (uid vs proc.supervisor_id/implant_incharge_id) with same_person_both bypass. Rejection path atomically updates status, clears pending_end_treatment, downgrades every Treatment Ended → Failed in phase2_survival_review.implants, records rejection metadata (by_name/by_role/comment/initiated_by), and notifies the initiator. Approval path stamps supervisor_approved_by, transitions to pending_end_treatment_incharge (or terminates on same-person-both), copies decision_maker/reason/by_role to root fields, and notifies next actor.

server.py L4310-4364: `_resolve_active_implants_inline` cleanly implements R0 → R{n} substitution — `_r0` snapshot preserved, R{n} explicit-overwrite semantics for R{n}-only fields (None from R{n} correctly clears R0 values like healing_abutment_mm), anatomy fields only overwritten when R{n} provides them, `_active_revision=True` flag correctly stamped. Verified: `healing_abutment_mm` becomes None when R{n} prosthetic_component is 'Cover Screw'; bone_type preserved from R0; system/diameter/length correctly overwritten.

server.py L4552-4597: survival-review handler determines the initial pending status based on initiator_role — student → pending_end_treatment_supervisor, supervisor + supervisor!=incharge → pending_end_treatment_incharge (skips supervisor step), supervisor + same-person-both → treatment_ended immediately, implant_incharge → treatment_ended immediately. Matches iter-352 spec.

server.py L2182 / L2325 / L2421: dashboard queries now include both pending_end_treatment_supervisor and pending_end_treatment_incharge in the PENDING status list — pending_my_approval count and /procedures?filter=pending_all correctly surface the new states.

EndTreatmentPendingBanner.tsx: banner renders inside procedures/[id].tsx when status matches; canAct correctly gates Approve/Reject visibility (only assigned supervisor for _supervisor, only assigned in-charge for _incharge). Reject modal enforces non-empty comment client-side via Alert before firing the API call. All 5 required testIDs present (end-treatment-pending-banner, end-treatment-approve-btn, end-treatment-reject-btn, end-treatment-reject-comment, end-treatment-reject-confirm).

procedures/[id].tsx L950-956, L961-972, L978-1018: three-way banner rendering — pending (EndTreatmentPendingBanner), rejected (with end-treatment-rejected-banner testID), and terminated (termination-banner + termination-download-btn) — is mutually exclusive by status/flag. Correct precedence.

MINOR: EndTreatmentPendingBanner.tsx line 51-52 uses procedure.supervisor_name / procedure.implant_incharge_name if present, else 'Supervisor'/'Implant In-Charge'. In the seeded case the resolved 'Awaiting Dr. Abhijit Patil approval' text shows the FE is receiving supervisor_name populated by GET /procedures/{id} — good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the four required in-browser flows (pending banner render, reject with comment, approve → termination banner, student read-only view). No regressions observed on the case detail page. Deep-link 403 issue from iter-299 is now MITIGATED — localStorage token mirroring in utils/api.ts works, deep navigation to /procedures/{id} succeeded on the first request.
